Row 30, canvas 2 (canvas 1 holds its 512 files)

p23.text: Phase 23 · The brand mark (D120, D122, tutor_central_logo v1.2.0): the cap, T and C in place of the book. The app icon, sign-in, the launch screen, the website's header and footer, the portal's header and door; the tile beside the name marigold with an ink mark on dark grounds, charcoal with a marigold mark on light; the website's link preview. Row 31, canvas 2
